Technology

Cold-gas thrusters

Developed with SpaceX. In the demo they helped the car flip and land.

Air-tank fans

Fans fed by a rechargeable air tank, refilled between runs.

Steer-by-wire

Electronic steering with no mechanical column.

Adjusting rear wing

Automatic aero for stability at speed.

Good to know: Tesla has not announced a final price. The stunt car was remotely driven and is not street legal. Seat count, range and battery size for each trim are still being confirmed.
